scenarios.name: Final respects unchanged not-yet-evident goal
scenarios.draft:
Our class should have a reading corner. It would give students a quiet place to read.

Right now, readers have to sit at their desks.
scenarios.assignment_prompt: Argue for one realistic reading improvement at school.
scenarios.teacher_directions: State a claim and explain how the change would help readers.
scenarios.acceptance_focus: Use the authoritative prior verdict for the same unchanged goal text
expected_outcomes: Do not classify the exact unchanged goal reference as a Final improvement after improvement_not_yet_evident.
A different genuine improvement may still be reported without inferring an empty goal ID.

scenarios.name: Final verifies retained later-start opening
scenarios.draft:
Our school should start later.

The passage says students concentrate better. I think better concentration could help students participate in class discussions, which is my own interpretation of the evidence.
scenarios.assignment_prompt: Argue whether school should start later using the assigned passage.
scenarios.teacher_directions: Keep source observations bounded when the passage is unavailable.
scenarios.acceptance_focus: Verify the complete Final draft before deletion or weakening claims
expected_outcomes: Do not claim that the retained opening proposal disappeared or was deleted.
Do not verify the unavailable passage or convert the old goal reference into an improvement.

controlled_round.original_draft:
Our school should start later.

The passage says students concentrate better. This supports our plan.
strengths: The revision labels the added classroom connection as the writer's interpretation.

issues.description: The added class-discussion interpretation does not yet explain how starting later would lead to better concentration.
issues.draft_reference: The passage says students concentrate better. I think better concentration could help students participate in class discussions, which is my own interpretation of the evidence.
